title: Selected NSF award records for an experimental institutional map

methodology.selection: Purposive evidence sample: quantum-materials foundries/CIQM and training awards represented in the directory; selected MRSECs with quantum-materials research; all eight 2026 NSF QLCI awards. This is not a systematic or exhaustive quantum-materials funding search.
methodology.universe: 19 unique NSF prime-award records at 14 recipient universities, with record starts spanning 2013–2026. No DOE/DOD/private funding totals are included.
methodology.aggregation: Deduplicate by NSF award ID. Sum only fundsObligatedAmt for selected scope types and dates. Assign each full prime award only once, to its named recipient university. Do not multiply by partner count or add an award again via linked center entries. A university total means selected records only.

scopeDefinitions.quantum-materials: Award abstract explicitly centers research/training on quantum materials; includes full award administration and education, not pure research spend.
scopeDefinitions.mixed-materials: Whole materials-center award includes quantum-materials and other research; quantum-only budget is unknown.
scopeDefinitions.broader-qis: Whole quantum information science institute award; contains materials connections but not restricted to quantum materials.

limitations: Amounts are cumulative obligations as retrieved, not cash spent, annual budgets, direct awards to every collaborator, or total funding received by a university.
Funding amounts across different start dates and award durations are not a controlled performance comparison. Show dates and allow scope/date filtering.
Missing award records mean not assessed in this selected sample, not zero support.
The original announced or estimated amount can differ from cumulative obligations after amendments; do not merge these fields.
Some listed award end dates are past and some are estimated future dates. Do not describe all sums as current active funding.
MRSEC and QLCI institution matches do not establish funding for a university degree/minor/certificate; entryMatchType distinguishes university-level links.
The sample is appropriate for evidence-backed highlights, not a ranking of university research quality or a comprehensive national funding leaderboard.
NSF award web pages depend on client rendering and may show an empty shell in text-only readers; the official API URL supplies the verified record.
methodology.recommendedUiLabel: Selected NSF obligations (USD; prime recipient; as of 29 Oct 2026)
methodology.recommendedMissingLabel: No award assessed in this sample
methodology.retrieval: Fetched each official record by award ID and retained monetary/date fields; scope tags were assigned by reading the official abstract.

excludedExample.reason: The 2026 Harvard MRSEC abstract focuses on soft materials, hydrogels and vesicles, with no explicit quantum-materials research theme; excluded despite Harvard hosting other quantum activity.
